0.original: Urianger is quite glad for your company.

25.original: Stand watch at the designated location and defeat any enemies that appear.

26.original: Stand watch at the designated location.

29.original: Search for Runningway at the designated location.

48.original: I thank thee for accompanying me.

49.original: 'Tis a simple plan, in truth. We shall not be long away from Bestways Burrow.

50.original: Difficult decisions must needs be made in the coming days, but I nevertheless believe we are all of one mind in our desire to save the people of Etheirys.

51.original: To make clear our resolve to the Loporrits, I would offer them a gift. But its making doth require a most singular ingredient.

52.original: Ah, an abundance of spongoi. Excellent.

53.original: I chanced to spy this aggregation when crossing Zodiark's erstwhile prison.

54.original: Using a spell taught to me by the Nu Mou, I believe these shall suffice for the gift I would fashion.

55.original: The magick requireth considerable concentration, however. Might I prevail upon thee to stand watch whilst I perform the incantation?

57.original: Urianger is wholly absorbed in weaving his enchantment. Until his work is complete, he will need to be kept safe from harm...

58.original: Surveying the nearby area, you see no sign of potential threats. This would be a good opportunity to see how Urianger is faring...

60.original: Urianger remains fixated on his work...

62.original: A magicked ink, every onze as efficacious as that crafted by the Nu Mou.

63.original: Rare is the occasion I would conjure mine own, but is nevertheless a most useful skill.

64.original: The resulting product is, admittedly, possessed of no preternatural properties, but its hue is one of mine own choosing, which I pray the Loporrits will appreciate.

65.original: (-???-)<hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Urianger! Oh, thank goodness. I thought you had been eaten, or had perhaps fallen into a crater.

66.original: Y'shtola has been looking all over for you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. She says she needs to speak with you about something most urgent. Dire, even.

67.original: She was also quite clear that she wishes to speak with <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> <hex:021A020203>alone<hex:021A020103>. Which means, I'm afraid, you must stay behind, Urianger.

68.original: But worry not! It just so happens we need your help with an errand─delivering a package from the Watcher's Palace to Bestways Burrow. It's quite large and heavy─perhaps even too heavy, for we poor Loporrits─and we would be ever so grateful if you could lend us a hand.

70.original: Well, I suppose I should be going, then...

71.original: How about an extra pair of hands before I go and meet with Y'shtola?

74.original: I-I mean, yes, very good. Let us not keep you, then. She said she would be waiting for you in Greatest Endsvale...or somewhere thereabouts. I'm sure you'll find her soon enough.

75.original: No, no, that won't be necessary. Urianger's help should more than suffice.

76.original: And I'm sure you don't want to risk getting on Y'shtola's bad side by keeping her waiting. She seems...prickly. Now, off with you.

77.original: Are you insinuating I would betray the trust of Hydaelyn's chosen? Or worse─do anything to risk getting on Y'shtola's bad side!?

78.original: She's clearly not one to be crossed, nor made to wait. Now, off with you!

79.original: Worry not, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I shan't be long.

80.original: Everything is all right with Urianger, then? That's a relief.

82.original: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We thought you would be away for far longer.

83.original: A dire emergency? I said no such thing.

84.original: But as you are here, I could use your assistance with one small matter.

85.original: Runningway, a companion of Growingway's, apparently has much to tell us of the Final Days.

86.original: The problem, however, is that he is determined to live up to his name, refusing to stay still long enough for us to hold a conversation.

87.original: Is there anywhere he's likely to stop and rest? Or perhaps there's a way to slow him down?

88.original: Wh-What's the rush? I was thinking we should wait here, maybe enjoy a cold mug of carrot juice, and...no? <sigh> Well, if it's really that important...

89.original: You can try using these...balls. Of mousse flesh. Not to be confused with...the other thing.

90.original: Ahem. Runningway's other notable feature is his incessant chatter, so you'll have no trouble finding him in a crowd. And when you do, try lobbing your balls at him.

91.original: Crude, but if it proves effective... He was here in Greatest Endsvale when last I saw him. Let us split up and find him.

92.original: Search your surroundings for Runningway. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target Runningway and throw mousse balls with <hex:020823E4E95101FF10024804F2022203EE81910248020103FF0C021E0210032F021E02090303>.

93.original: Hm? Yes, I'm Runningway. Do you mind explaining why you hit me in the face with your balls... Of mousse flesh?

94.original: <hex:021A020203>I'm<hex:021A020103> highly knowledgeable about the Final Days?

95.original: Hah, that's the most ridiculous thing I've heard since I woke up! Who told you that joke?

96.original: As if we've got time to look into the Final Days when there's so much to do before the great voyage.

97.original: It's true that Hydaelyn did impart to us some knowledge of the event, but I know about as much as any other Loporrit around here. Less, probably.

98.original: I don't know why anyone would think it's funny to go around telling people I'm an expert, but they'd better hope I don't get my paws on them!

99.original: Sorry I couldn't be of more help, but if there's nothing else, I've work to do!

101.original: Any luck? I tried near the entrance, but there was no sign of him.

102.original: Oh no, you caught him? I-I mean... Well done you...

103.original: I could find neither hide nor...hair of him. How did you fare?

104.original: So, he knows no more than the others.

107.original: I misremembered. Yes, that's it! I misremembered. Terribly sorry about that.

108.original: Hmmm. Afraid I'm drawing a blank, though. Try as I might, I can't remember who I was thinking of.

109.original: On an unrelated note, what of Urianger? I assume you spoke with him earlier, but did he say when he'll be returning?

110.original: On his way to the Watcher's Palace with Livingway?

111.original: Between Growingway's sudden lapse of memory and our lack of other leads, maybe our time would be better spent lending Urianger a hand.

112.original: Wh-What!? Now hold on a moment!

113.original: It's all coming back to me. Yes, I remember!

114.original: The information you're looking for is in the archives. Yes, that's where you'll find all sorts of useful knowledge, including that pertaining to the Final Days.
